newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cultus in deal to sell Iona gas reservoir.
newsitem.headline: Cultus in deal to sell Iona gas reservoir.

text.p: Cultus Petroleum NL said on Friday it had entered into an agreement with the Gas Transmission Corporation (GTC) of Victoria to sell the Iona gas reservoir in western Victoria.
Cultus said the agreement converted an option held by the GTC since May 1995 to acquire the reservoir and any remaining gas reserves on March 24, 1998.

No purchase price was available as the consideration is based on a formula for the value of remaining gas reserves at the transfer date. The formula is based on orderly production and sales of reserves at prices and costs determined in accordance with an escalator based on the consumer price index.

Cultus said that while it believed the amount would be substantial, it had not yet agreed with GTC on the remaining reserves and other formula inputs. Cultus shares closed steady at A$3.50 on turnover of 388,565 shares.
